# uptimeeye_status_page (Resource)

A public or private status page. Sections (with their monitors and scheduled tasks) are part of the page document and are upserted atomically with the page — they have no API of their own. Server-managed and plan-gated settings (subscribers, white-label, custom-domain flags) are not modeled here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeeye_status_page" "public" {
  name  = "Example Status"
  slug  = "example-status"
  theme = "auto"

  sections = [{
    name = "API"
    monitors = [{
      monitor_id = uptimeeye_monitor.api.id
    }]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the status page.
- `slug` (String) URL slug under which the page is served.

### Optional

- `brand_color` (String) Brand accent color (e.g. `#1a2b3c`).
- `hide_powered_by` (Boolean) Hide the "powered by UptimeEye" footer (requires a plan that allows it).
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the logo shown on the page.
- `sections` (Attributes List) Ordered sections of the page. Each section groups monitors and scheduled tasks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))
- `subscriptions_enabled` (Boolean) Allow visitors to subscribe to status updates.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for organizing status pages.
- `theme` (String) Color theme of the page. One of `dark`, `light`, `auto`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Status page identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--sections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sections`

Required:

- `name` (String) Section heading.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Section description shown under the heading.
- `monitors` (Attributes List) Monitors displayed in this section, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections--monitors))
- `scheduled_tasks` (Attributes List) Scheduled tasks displayed in this section, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections--scheduled_tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--sections--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sections.monitors`

Required:

- `monitor_id` (String) Id of the monitor to display.

Optional:

- `show_response_time` (Boolean) Show the response time chart for this monitor.
- `show_uptime` (Boolean) Show the uptime percentage for this monitor.


<a id="nestedatt--sections--scheduled_tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sections.scheduled_tasks`

Required:

- `scheduled_task_id` (String) Id of the scheduled task to display.
